whatChanged.summary: The receipt page says 'Thank you for your order' in place of 'Order complete'.
whatChanged.laneReason: A wording change on the receipt page.

cards.question: Should the receipt page keep the old wording for gift orders?

blocks.paragraph: What a gift buyer reads on their receipt is a promise about how the shop talks to customers, and only you can decide that tone.
The new wording thanks the buyer, but a gift order's receipt goes to the buyer and the new text reads oddly there. This is decision item 1435 on your list, and it is answered here.
The new wording ships on gift receipts as well.

options.label: a. Use the new wording everywhere
options.consequence: Gift buyers read the thank-you line too; one wording to keep.

options.label: b. Keep the old wording for gift orders
options.consequence: Gift receipts stay as they are; the PR keeps a second wording to maintain.

options.label: c. Hold the PR until gift orders are reworded
options.consequence: The PR goes back and returns with a new sheet once gift receipts are settled.

recommendation.text: a — Use the new wording everywhere
recommendation.reason: One wording is cheaper to keep, and gift buyers are still thanked for their order.

cards.question: Should the receipt page show the order total in the thank-you line?

blocks.paragraph: Showing money on a page a customer may share is a privacy call about your customers, and only you can make it.
A designer proposed adding the total to the thank-you line. The review found no rule against it and no rule for it.
The thank-you line ships without the total.

options.label: a. Leave the total out
options.consequence: The thank-you line stays short and shows no money.

options.label: b. Add the total in a follow-up
options.consequence: This ships without the total; a follow-up adds it if you want it.

options.label: c. Add the total before merge
options.consequence: The PR goes back to add the total and returns with a new sheet.

recommendation.reason: A receipt that is shared would show what the customer paid.
